recommendation: Retain exact saved actual-invoice consent and leave charge admission disabled until the owner implements durable operation/recovery, authoritative publication and Core capacity reservation/consumption. Do not swap only payment_behavior to pending_if_incomplete.

documentedNativeBehavior.claim: Pending updates ordinarily apply the requested quantity only after payment; always_invoice attempts payment inside the subscription update. Decline/SCA can leave changes pending.
Pinned proration_date is supported. Pending updates require charge_automatically and supported payment methods; current unversioned method list is not proof of every Acacia deployment capability.
Expiry voids the invoice/discards changes; earlier billing boundaries and conflicting later updates can remove it. A replacement can create a different invoice.
Outstanding metered usage can be included and discarded if the pending update expires. Schedules/thresholds require explicit handling.
default_incomplete explicitly awaits invoice PaymentIntent confirmation; always_invoice ordinarily attempts collection. API supports the installed payment_behavior union.
A preview is not a saved payable invoice. Matching proration_date matches proration; exchange rates can change. This does not establish an atomic total-amount guard.

auto_advance=false stops automatic invoice advancement/retries. Setting it after a pending subscription update cannot precede that update's immediate payment attempt (inference from operation ordering).
No portal configuration parameter means default configuration. Repository code does not establish its deployed features.
Webhook delivery can be duplicated/out of order, including events sharing a second; retrieve authoritative objects and track event IDs.
V1 idempotency can cache a 500; keys can be pruned after at least 24 hours. Expiry is not evidence an unknown dispatch never occurred.

incompatibilities.detail: prepare currently obtains an open unpaid frozen invoice/PI. confirm uses that exact ID/fingerprint. Native pending update can already have charged or require SCA before prepare returns, violating these states.
372 consent proof binds actual invoice/PI before explicit confirmation. Paid/SCA/processing without proof is quarantined. Never synthesize the proof retrospectively after native collection.

Strict invoice policy refuses credits/tax/discounts/mixed or non-pinned-period lines. Native charging before actual validation can charge a subsequently refused invoice. Full preview alone is not a provider-side amount cap.

Canonical subscriptions can include the metered overage price; Portal uses default config. sync publishes delivered status/quantity without authoritative refresh, fence or publication revision. Native pending quantity helps provisional provider state but does not repair publisher ordering or external writers.

Existing handler covers subscription create/update/delete, Checkout and payment_failed log. Pending applied/expired, invoice paid/action-required recovery and durable operation correlation are absent; event ledger alone is not a publication CAS.

Trial conversion creates subscriptions and syncs; lockout/cancellation/retention policies consume published state. Native updates only address existing eligible subscriptions; preserve canonical admin/negative lifecycle decisions instead of hiding them indiscriminately.

externalWriters.finding: Portal, already-issued Checkout/Portal URLs, Dashboard operators and other billing/lifecycle writers do not acquire a candidate DB lock. Native pending_update is not an exclusive lock or provider CAS.
externalWriters.minimumOwnerAgreement: Inventory and explicitly control quantity/cancel writers and issued capabilities; verify deployed Portal features with its owner. Reconcile authoritative invoice/PI/subscription and suspend conversion on drift. Disabling new Portal creation alone cannot establish existing-session or Dashboard exclusion.
externalWriters.prohibitedShortcut: Do not claim read fingerprint + update is provider CAS, or automatically reissue a removed pending update under a fresh idempotency key.

singleUseCapacity.finding: Payment and provider-applied quantity do not reserve a slot for one prospect. Current manual/Meri create, CSV, LDA and reactivation can compete; prospect row lock does not serialize tenant capacity.
singleUseCapacity.ownerContract: Core transaction must lock tenant capacity, reserve exactly the paid attempt/prospect/invoice entitlement and consume it uniquely with client insert + prospect link + audit. All capacity writers/reactivation must honor reservations. Existing-client linking must not consume a new slot; idempotent retry returns the same client. Onboard settlement/publication and Core consumption need explicit cross-service ownership using shared DB atomicity, not two unrelated commits.
